name: Bangladesh
leaders: President Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir (BNP), elected by parliament on 20 August 2026; Prime Minister Tarique Rahman (BNP)
leadersIs: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir forseti (BNP), kjörinn af þinginu 20. ágúst 2026; Tarique Rahman forsætisráðherra (BNP)
summary: The Jatiya Sangsad elected BNP secretary general Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir as president on 20 August 2026 with 255 votes to 88 for Oli Ahmed, the candidate of the Jamaat-led opposition alliance, in the first contested presidential vote in 35 years. The election followed President Mohammed Shahabuddin's resignation in July; the largely ceremonial post acts on the prime minister's advice and the next general election is due by 2031.
summaryIs: Jatiya Sangsad kaus Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir, framkvæmdastjóra BNP, forseta 20. ágúst 2026 með 255 atkvæðum gegn 88 hjá Oli Ahmed, frambjóðanda stjórnarandstöðubandalagsins undir forystu Jamaat, í fyrstu forsetakosningunum í 35 ár þar sem fleiri en einn voru í framboði. Kosningin fór fram eftir að Mohammed Shahabuddin forseti sagði af sér í júlí; embættið er að mestu táknrænt og forsetinn fer að ráðum forsætisráðherra, en næstu þingkosningar eiga að fara fram í síðasta lagi 2031.

lastElection.outcome: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir (BNP) was elected president by parliament with 255 votes to 88 for Oli Ahmed, backed by the Jamaat-led alliance, with 343 of 349 eligible members voting; he succeeded acting president Hafiz Uddin Ahmad, the BNP Speaker, who had served since Mohammed Shahabuddin resigned on 24 July.
lastElection.outcomeIs: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir (BNP) var kjörinn forseti á þinginu með 255 atkvæðum gegn 88 hjá Oli Ahmed, sem bandalagið undir forystu Jamaat studdi, og 343 af 349 atkvæðisbærum þingmönnum greiddu atkvæði; hann tók við af Hafiz Uddin Ahmad, þingforseta úr BNP, sem gegnt hafði embættinu frá því að Mohammed Shahabuddin sagði af sér 24. júlí.
lastElection.winner: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir (BNP), succeeding Mohammed Shahabuddin
